    D_VALUES_1: tl.constexpr,
    D_OUTPUT_0: tl.constexpr,

    weighted_accumulator = tl.zeros((2, 16), tl.float32)

            mask=(row_block_offsets[:, None] < N_ROW_BLOCK) & (selected_start_offsets[None, :] < N_SELECTED_LOOP),

            load_values_ptrs,
            mask=selected_start_offsets[:, None] < D_VALUES_0,
            other=0.0,
            cache_modifier=".cg",
        )

        softmax_update_tile_max = tl.max(logits_tile, axis=1)
        softmax_update_new_max = tl.maximum(running_max, softmax_update_tile_max)
        softmax_update_empty = softmax_update_new_max == float("-inf")
        softmax_update_old_scale = tl.where(softmax_update_empty, 1.0, tl.exp(running_max - softmax_update_new_max))
        softmax_update_weights = tl.where(logits_tile == float("-inf"), 0.0, tl.exp(logits_tile - softmax_update_new_max[:, None]))

        running_sum = softmax_update_new_sum
        weighted_accumulator = softmax_update_new_accumulator
    # CAKE_FINALIZE:softmax_update
    normalized_output = tl.where(running_sum[:, None] > 0.0, weighted_accumulator / running_sum[:, None], 0.0)
